quests.instruction: Which family member is a woman even older than your grandmother, from an earlier generation?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: Count back three generations from yourself.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother is a woman even older than your grandmother, from an earlier generation.
quests.funFact: A family photo with four generations together, including a great-grandmother, is a rare and special treasure!

quests.instruction: Which family member might one day call you 'Uncle' or 'Aunt'?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: He is your sibling's own son.
quests.explanation: Nephew might call you 'Uncle' or 'Aunt', since he is your sibling's son.
quests.funFact: Being called 'Uncle' or 'Aunt' by a nephew is a special title many people are proud of!

quests.instruction: Which family member was born at nearly the same moment as you, from the very same pregnancy, and is a boy?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: You and this brother grew together before either of you were born.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother was born at nearly the same moment as you, from the same pregnancy.
quests.funFact: Twins can spend many months growing together before they are both born!

quests.instruction: Which family member's own children would grow up to be your grand-nieces or grand-nephews?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: Think of your sibling's daughter.
quests.explanation: Niece's own children would grow up to be your grand-nieces or grand-nephews one day.
quests.funFact: Family trees can keep branching for many generations, adding new titles like grand-niece!

quests.instruction: Which family member shares your very own birthday, down to the exact date, and is a girl?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: She was born at the very same time you were, not just the same year.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister shares your very own birthday, down to the exact date, and is a girl.
quests.funFact: Twins often develop their very own special way of understanding each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member's own mother is the very same person as your grandmother?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She is your mom's sister, or your dad's sister.
quests.explanation: Aunt's own mother is the same person as your grandmother, since she is your parent's sibling.
quests.funFact: This kind of family puzzle shows how one grandmother can connect many different relatives!

quests.instruction: Which word would a grandmother use to describe her own grown girl?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: This is the word for a parent's own female child, at any age.
quests.explanation: Daughter is the word a grandmother would use to describe her own grown girl, since she stays her daughter forever.
quests.funFact: A grandmother often loves telling her own daughter's childhood stories to her grandchildren!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man that your own parent grew up with as a sibling?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He shares a childhood home with your mom or dad.
quests.explanation: Uncle is a man that your own parent grew up with as a sibling.
quests.funFact: Uncles and their siblings often share funny childhood stories about growing up together!

quests.instruction: Which family member's parent calls your own parent 'brother' or 'sister'?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: That parent is your aunt or uncle.
quests.explanation: Cousin's parent calls your own parent 'brother' or 'sister', since that parent is your aunt or uncle.
quests.funFact: Working out how you are related to a cousin is a fun way to explore your own family tree!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a nephew, but seen from his own parents' point of view instead of his aunt or uncle's?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: This word is used only by that boy's own mother and father.
quests.explanation: Son describes the same boy who is a nephew to his aunt or uncle, but seen from his own parents' point of view.
quests.funFact: The very same boy can be a son, a nephew, a cousin, and a brother, all to different relatives at once!

quests.instruction: Which family member might your own grandmother call 'Mom'?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: She is your grandmother's own mother.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother might be called 'Mom' by your own grandmother, since she is her mother.
quests.funFact: Just like your parent was once your grandparent's child, your grandparent was once their own parent's child!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy whose grandparent is also your own parent?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: He is the son of your brother or sister.
quests.explanation: Nephew is a boy whose grandparent is also your own parent, since his parent is your sibling.
quests.funFact: A nephew often enjoys hearing family stories from his grandparent, just as you do from yours!

quests.instruction: Which family member might look very similar to you, if the two of you are twins, and is a boy?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: Twins sometimes look alike, but not always.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother might look very similar to you, since some twins share a very close resemblance.
quests.funFact: Not all twins look alike — some twins look very different from each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the daughter side of your sibling's children?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: She is a girl, and her parent is your own brother or sister.
quests.explanation: Niece is the daughter side of your sibling's children.
quests.funFact: A niece and a nephew from the very same parents would also be brother and sister to each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a sister who celebrates a birthday on the exact same date as yours, every year?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: This is not simply a sister close in age — the date matches exactly.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister celebrates a birthday on the exact same date as yours, every single year.
quests.funFact: Twins sometimes enjoy dressing alike for their shared birthday, though plenty of twins prefer to dress differently!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a woman that your own parent grew up with as a sibling?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She shares a childhood home with your mom or dad.
quests.explanation: Aunt is a woman that your own parent grew up with as a sibling.
quests.funFact: Aunts and their siblings often share funny childhood stories about growing up together!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a niece, but seen from her own parents' point of view instead of her aunt or uncle's?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: This word is used only by that girl's own mother and father.
quests.explanation: Daughter describes the same girl who is a niece to her aunt or uncle, but seen from her own parents' point of view.
quests.funFact: The very same girl can be a daughter, a niece, a cousin, and a sister, all to different relatives at once!

quests.instruction: Which family member's own father is the very same person as your grandfather?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He is your mom's brother, or your dad's brother.
quests.explanation: Uncle's own father is the same person as your grandfather, since he is your parent's sibling.
quests.funFact: This kind of family puzzle shows how one grandfather can connect many different relatives!

quests.instruction: Which family member is neither your sibling nor your niece or nephew, but is still your own age group in the extended family?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: You share one grandparent with this relative, but not a parent.
quests.explanation: Cousin is neither your sibling nor your niece or nephew, but is still your own age group in the extended family.
quests.funFact: Cousins are a wonderful way to feel connected to family even outside your own home!

quests.instruction: Which word would a grandmother use to describe her own grown boy?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: This is the word for a parent's own male child, at any age.
quests.explanation: Son is the word a grandmother would use to describe her own grown boy, since he stays her son forever.
quests.funFact: You stay someone's son or daughter for your entire life, even after you grow up!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the oldest woman in your close family, three generations above you?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: She raised your own grandmother or grandfather.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother is often the oldest woman in your close family, three generations above you.
quests.funFact: A great-grandmother has often lived through many decades of changes in the world!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the son side of your sibling's children?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: He is a boy, and his parent is your own brother or sister.
quests.explanation: Nephew is the son side of your sibling's children.
quests.funFact: A nephew and a niece from the very same parents would also be brother and sister to each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy born from the very same pregnancy as you?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: He grew alongside you before either of you were born.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother is a boy born from the very same pregnancy as you.
quests.funFact: There are two main kinds of twins: identical twins and fraternal twins!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl who is not your own child, but is closely related through your sibling?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: Her parent is your brother or your sister.
quests.explanation: Niece is a girl who is not your own child, but is closely related to you through your sibling.
quests.funFact: Many aunts and uncles say watching a niece grow up is one of family life's greatest joys!

quests.instruction: Which family member might share your exact looks, if the two of you are twins, and is a girl?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: Identical twins can look remarkably alike, though not every twin does.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister might share your exact looks, since identical twins can look remarkably alike.
quests.funFact: Even twins who look alike usually have small differences that help family and friends tell them apart!

quests.instruction: Which family member has lived through the most years of any woman in your close family?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: She belongs to the very oldest generation you might know.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandmother has often lived through the most years of any woman in your close family.
quests.funFact: Some great-grandmothers can share memories from many decades before you were even born!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the son of your sister or your brother?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: From his point of view, you are his aunt or uncle.
quests.explanation: Nephew is the son of your sister or your brother.
quests.funFact: If you become an aunt or uncle one day, your sibling's son will be your nephew!

quests.instruction: Which family member shares your very own birthday, down to the exact date, and is a boy?
quests.question: Twin Brother
quests.hint: He was born at the very same time you were, not just the same year.
quests.explanation: Twin Brother shares your very own birthday, down to the exact date, and is a boy.
quests.funFact: Some twins are born on different sides of midnight, giving them two different birth dates!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the daughter of your sister or your brother?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: From her point of view, you are her aunt or uncle.
quests.explanation: Niece is the daughter of your sister or your brother.
quests.funFact: If you become an aunt or uncle one day, your sibling's daughter will be your niece!

quests.instruction: Which family member entered the world together with you on your one shared birthday, and is a girl?
quests.question: Twin Sister
quests.hint: This sister's birth story is the same day as your own.
quests.explanation: Twin Sister entered the world together with you on your shared birthday.
quests.funFact: Some twins invent their own private words or games that only the two of them understand!
